turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Morning, Hana! How's the lab vibe today?

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Hey Dee! It's buzzing a bit, but I just got the final approval—The name chosen for the reading room is MAPLE3-2214.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Nice! MAPLE3-2214 has a nice ring to it. It'll be a great spot for quiet data crunching.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Exactly, and the coffee machine finally stopped sputtering, so I'm feeling more awake already.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Glad to hear that. Did you manage to finish the calibration on the spectrometer?

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Almost. I ran a couple of test runs and the baseline looks solid now.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Awesome. I was thinking of grabbing a bite after the next set of measurements—any cravings?

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: I'm in the mood for something light, maybe a salad. Want to join me at the break area?

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Sounds perfect. After that, I need to update the lab notebook with today's observations.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Great plan. Let's wrap up our runs and head over—I'll bring the notes for MAPLE3-2214 so we can double‑check the signage later.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Hey Lea, nice to see you! How's your morning going?

turns.speaker: lea11
turns.text: Morning, Ada! It’s been pretty busy, but I managed to grab a latte before the rush.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Lucky you—this place has the best croissants. I’m just waiting for my flat white.

turns.speaker: lea11
turns.text: The combination for the rooftop garden is RIDGE3-2133.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Got it, thanks! I was hoping to sneak in a quick walk up there later.

turns.speaker: lea11
turns.text: I was there this afternoon and the sun was just perfect for the herbs.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Sounds amazing. I’ve got a few sketches to finish before the meeting this afternoon.

turns.speaker: lea11
turns.text: Do you think you’ll have time to grab a snack after? There’s a new pastry stand opening next door.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Probably, especially if the sketches wrap up early. I’ve been reading a mystery novel on the train.

turns.speaker: lea11
turns.text: Nice! Let’s catch up again after lunch and compare notes on the garden.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Hey Dee, nice to see you here. How's your morning going?

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Hey Ada, it's been pretty calm. I just grabbed a coffee and found a quiet corner.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Perfect spot for some reading. I was just checking the schedule for the lab equipment.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Oh right, you needed the freezer for your experiment, didn't you?

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Yes, exactly. The booking reference for the freezer is HARBOR1-1763.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Got it, I'll make sure they have it ready when you arrive.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Thanks. By the way, have you seen the new mystery novel that just arrived?

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: I haven't yet, but I heard it's getting good reviews. Planning to borrow it later.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Sounds like a good plan. I might pop over after I finish my notes.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Enjoy your reading and good luck with the freezer booking!

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Hey Ivo, nice weather out here, isn’t it?

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: It really is. The roses are finally opening.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: I was just trimming the lavender; it smells amazing.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: I love how the garden feels like a little reset after a busy week.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Did you manage to finish that report you were working on?

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: The combination for the seminar room is QUILL3-3155.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Got it, thanks! I’ll grab the keys and head over later.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: I’m planning to water the tomatoes before the sun gets too strong.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Sounds good. Any plans for the evening?

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Just a quiet dinner and maybe a short walk around the pond.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Good morning, Hana! The roses are finally opening up.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Morning, Fay! They look gorgeous, brightening the whole garden.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: I was just checking the garden shed and noticed a new label.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Oh? What does it say?

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: The label on the darkroom is MOSAIC1-9551.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: That’s handy! I’ll make a note of it for the next inventory.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: How was your morning walk? The dew made the path sparkle.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: It was refreshing, and the birds were singing louder than usual.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Do you think we should plant some lavender near the bench?

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Great idea! It’ll add scent and attract more pollinators.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Hey Hana, how's your morning going?

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Good, thanks! Just finished setting up the new equipment.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Nice! Anything exciting planned for today?

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: The name chosen for the darkroom is FROST3-6856.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: That's a cool name. Does it have a story behind it?

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: We wanted something that feels crisp and a bit mysterious, so we went with that.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: I love it. I was just polishing the lenses in the back room.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Sounds satisfying. Did you get a chance to grab lunch yet?

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Not yet, thinking about a quick salad. How about you?

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: I grabbed a sandwich earlier, so I'm good. Ready to dive back in after a short break.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Hey Kai, how's your morning going?

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished calibrating the spectrometer.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Nice, I was about to head to the darkroom. Do you have the lock code?

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: The combination for the darkroom is GARNET1-2226.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I’ll start the exposure run now.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: How did the sample prep turn out yesterday?

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: The yield was better than I expected, the crystals look really clear.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: That’s great to hear. A clean batch will make the analysis smoother.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Do you want to grab a coffee later? I could use a break.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: Sure thing, let’s meet by the water cooler in a bit.

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Morning everyone, how's the day shaping up so far?

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished calibrating the spectrograph.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Nice! I was just sorting the data from yesterday's run.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: The booking reference for the telescope dome is SAFFRON-2186.

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Got it, thanks for the heads‑up.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Do we still have time for the planetary transit observation tonight?

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Yes, the dome will be ready shortly after the morning checks.

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Great, I grabbed a fresh cup of coffee and I'm ready to dive in.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Awesome, let's meet in the control room in a few minutes.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Hey everyone, how's your afternoon going?

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished a stack of reference books.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Nice! I was just pulling a novel off the shelf and it looks promising.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: I started a new history biography earlier; the writing style is really engaging.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: The combination for the west stairwell is MAPLE1-6597.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Got it, thanks for the heads‑up! I’ll make sure to lock the door after I’m done.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Do you two have anything special planned after the library?

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: I’m meeting a colleague to brainstorm ideas for the upcoming exhibit.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: I’m heading to the café downstairs for a quick espresso before I head home.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Sounds perfect. Let’s catch up tomorrow and share what we discovered.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: Morning, everyone! How's the day treating you so far?

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished calibrating the spectrometer.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Nice! I was just sorting through the new reagent bottles.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: Did anyone check the status of the sample fridge?

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: The booking reference for the sample fridge is ORBIT-1495.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Got it, thanks! I’ll make sure the samples are logged under that reference.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: I grabbed a fresh cup of coffee—needed the boost for the data analysis.

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Same here, the new protocol is keeping me on my toes.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Alright, let’s reconvene after lunch and see where we stand.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Morning, Kai! How's the workshop treating you today?

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: Hey Jun! It's been busy, but I finally got the new CNC machine running.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Nice! I was just wrapping up the prototype for the new sensor.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: Cool, let me know when you're ready to test it. By the way, the password for the bike shed is CEDAR3-7264.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I might need to grab my bike later for the delivery run.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: No problem. Did you manage to finish the coffee orders this morning?

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Almost. I still have a couple of mugs left, but they're almost done.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: Great, the team will appreciate that. I also need to restock the toolbox.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: I saw some extra wrenches in the back room, they should be useful.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: Thanks, I'll check them out. See you later around the workbench.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: Morning, Jun. Did you get a chance to check the new cutter?

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Hey Bo, yeah I gave it a quick run. It feels smoother than the old one.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: Glad to hear that. I was tweaking the alignment before lunch.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: I grabbed a coffee and it helped me stay focused on the schematics.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: By the way, the password for the lab safe is RIDGE1-2314.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I'll make sure to lock the reagents after we finish.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: We still need to verify the sensor calibration before the afternoon session.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Sure thing. I have the multimeter ready and can double‑check the readings.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: After that, I think we can take a short break and grab a bite.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Sounds good. See you in a bit.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Morning, Gus! How's the experiment going today?

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Hey Fay, it's going well. I just finished calibrating the sensor.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Nice. Did you get a chance to check the sample from yesterday?

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Yes, it looks promising. By the way, the combination for the archive cabinet is HARBOR2-7364.

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I need to pull the protocol notes later.

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: No problem. Anything else you need before lunch?

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Just a quick coffee break. The new brew smells great.

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: I could use one too. Want to meet at the corner table?

turns.speaker: fay11
turns.text: Sounds perfect. I'll be there in a minute.

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: See you soon.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: Hey Ivo, nice to see you here. How's your research going?

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Pretty good, I finally cracked the citation for that paper on renewable energy. How about you?

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: I was just checking the schedule for the archive room. By the way, the combination for the loading dock is GARNET-9498.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Thanks, I needed that to pick up the boxes of journals we ordered.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: No problem. Did you manage to find a quiet corner to read?

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Yeah, I settled near the window. The light is perfect for skimming through articles.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: I might grab a coffee and then head over to the reference desk. Anything you need before I go?

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Just a reminder to return the scanner when you're done. It's due back soon.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: Got it. I'll swing by after my coffee. See you later.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: See you, enjoy the coffee!

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Morning, everyone! The roses are finally opening.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: Hey ada11, they look amazing. I was just trimming the lavender.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Nice work, bo11. The lavender smells great.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: I think the tomatoes are ready for a light watering.

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: I'll grab the hose. By the way, how's the new bench feeling?

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: It's sturdy, thanks for installing it yesterday.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Did anyone see the sunbird that visited the feeder?

turns.speaker: bo11
turns.text: I caught a glimpse near the oak tree. It was quick!

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: The booking reference for the greenhouse door is NECTAR2-4771.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Got it, thanks Hana. I'll make sure the door is unlocked for the afternoon.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Morning, Kai! Did you manage to finish the calibration on the spectrometer?

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: Hey Jun, almost. I just need to double‑check the baseline before I call it done.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Nice. I was stuck on the sample prep for a bit, but the new protocol is finally clicking.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: The label on the greenhouse door is EMBER-8967.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Got it, thanks. I’ll make a note of that for the logbook.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: No problem. By the way, did you see the coffee machine? It’s acting up again.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Yeah, it sputtered out half a cup this morning. Guess we’ll have to brew the old‑fashioned way.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: Sounds like a plan. I’ll swing by the pantry after I finish this run.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Cool, let me know if you need a hand with the data export later.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: Will do. Catch you later, Jun.

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Morning, cy11! How's the lab feeling today?

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Hey eli11, it's humming nicely. I just checked the schedule.

turns.speaker: eli11

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Great news! Want to take a short walk later and stretch our legs?

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Absolutely, a quick break would be refreshing.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Morning, Dee and Hana! How's the day shaping up?

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished calibrating the spectrometer. By the way, the combination for the freezer is COBALT3-3301.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Thanks, Dee! I was about to grab the new reagents. Did the calibration go smoothly?

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Yes, it was smooth. I’m prepping the tissue slides for the afternoon run.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Great, I’ll head over to the freezer now and store the samples.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Make sure the freezer stays cold; the cells are pretty sensitive.

turns.speaker: ada11
turns.text: Will do. Any thoughts on what we should have for lunch?

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: I’m in the mood for a salad, maybe with some fresh fruit on the side.

turns.speaker: hana11
turns.text: Sounds perfect. Let’s meet in the break room after we finish the current runs.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Hey cy11, nice to see you here. How's your morning going?

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Morning's been quiet, just sorting through some research papers.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: I was just looking for a spot to read. The window seat is my favorite.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Same here. By the way, the password for the rooftop garden is GARNET3-9070.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Oh, perfect! I was hoping to check out the garden later.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Yeah, the roses are blooming early this season.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Do you think it'll be crowded?

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Probably not too many people; it's usually a calm spot after lunch.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Great, I'll bring my notebook and maybe sketch a few plants.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Sounds like a plan. Let me know if you need any extra seeds for your project.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Hey kai11, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: It's been pretty good, just grabbed a coffee and was wandering the stacks.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Anything interesting catch your eye?

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: The label on the freezer is ORBIT3-4627.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: That's an odd label for a freezer.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: I thought maybe it was meant for some lab equipment.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Could be. They might have repurposed it for snacks.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: Probably. By the way, how's your research coming along?

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Slow but steady, I'm finally making progress on that chapter.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: Nice! Let's find a quiet corner and keep at it.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Hey, nice to see you both here in the quiet corner.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Same here, I was just looking for a spot to finish that article I started yesterday.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: The library's new windows let in a lot of sunshine; perfect for reading.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Did you manage to get the lab safe opened after the meeting?

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: The code for the lab safe is MOSAIC-9628.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Great, that should let us retrieve the samples we need for the experiment.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: I brought my notebook to jot down any ideas that pop up while I read.

turns.speaker: kai11
turns.text: I grabbed a coffee from the cafe downstairs; the aroma is already making me more focused.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Sounds like a productive afternoon—let's make the most of this quiet time.

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Hey Ivo, how's the workshop treating you today?

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Pretty good, just finished calibrating the new sensor array.

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Nice, I was just about to start on the panel wiring. Anything I should know before I dive in?

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: The combination for the boat house is MAPLE2-9424.

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Got it, thanks. That should make the access a lot smoother.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: The name chosen for the storeroom is EMBER2-5202.

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Perfect, I'll label the shelves accordingly.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Do you want to grab a coffee later? I could use a break.

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Sounds great, let's meet by the break area in a bit.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Cool, see you there.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Hey team, how's the morning shaping up in the workshop?

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Pretty good, I was just polishing the new wooden planks we got yesterday.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Nice, I finished assembling the metal brackets for the shelf and they're looking solid.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Great progress! By the way, do we have the combo for the boat house yet?

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Yes, the combination for the boat house is MAPLE2-9424.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Got it, thanks! I’ll swing by after lunch to lock up the tools.

turns.speaker: cy11
turns.text: Sounds good. Have you both had a chance to test the new hinge on the cabinet doors?

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: I gave it a quick try earlier; it moves smoothly and feels sturdy.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Same here, I think we’re all set for the next build phase.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Hey Jun, how's your morning going?

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Pretty good, just grabbed a latte. By the way, the name chosen for the west stairwell is LUMEN3-9924.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: That's a cool name. Any story behind it?

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Just a project thing, we needed something bright-sounding. Oh, and the password for the telescope dome is FROST-9588.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Got it. I hope the telescope's clear tonight.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Me too. Did you finish that report you were working on?

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Almost. I took a short break to enjoy the sunshine outside.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Nice. The weather's perfect for a walk after this.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Definitely. I might swing by the park later.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Sounds like a plan. Let me know if you need anything else.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Hey, how's your day going so far?

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Pretty hectic, but the coffee here is keeping me afloat.

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: By the way, the name chosen for the west stairwell is LUMEN3-9924.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: LUMEN3-9924? That's a sleek sounding name for a stairwell.

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Did they give it a backstory or just pick something futuristic?

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: I think it came up in the planning meeting this morning.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: I was just diving into a novel while waiting for my latte.

turns.speaker: eli11
turns.text: Nice! Any good books on your radar right now?

turns.speaker: jun11
turns.text: Probably just a quiet evening with a walk in the park later.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Morning, Gus! How's the experiment coming along?

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Hey Dee, it's going well. Just finished calibrating the sensors.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Nice. I was just checking the schedule for the seminar later.

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: The booking reference for the server rack is SAFFRON3-9244.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Got it, thanks. By the way, the password for the seminar room is MAPLE-1080.

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Perfect, that'll save us a lot of hassle.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Did you manage to get the samples from the freezer?

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Yes, they're ready for analysis. How's the data processing going?

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Smooth so far, just waiting on the final plots.

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Great. Let me know if you need any help with the visualization.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Will do. Thanks for the support!

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Anytime, Dee.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Morning, guys. Did you get a chance to look at the data from yesterday?

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Hey Dee, I skimmed it. The trends look promising, though I think we need to rerun the calibration.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: I agree. I also ran a quick check on the temperature sensors; they seem stable.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Great. By the way, the booking reference for the server rack is SAFFRON3-9244.

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Thanks, Dee. I'll add that to the inventory sheet.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Good call. I was about to ask you for it. Did you manage to get coffee yet?

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Just grabbed a cup. The espresso machine finally worked after the cleaning.

turns.speaker: gus11
turns.text: Nice! I need a caffeine boost too. My brain feels a bit sluggish after the long simulation.

turns.speaker: ivo11
turns.text: Same here. Maybe we should take a short walk to the break area and stretch.

turns.speaker: dee11
turns.text: Sounds like a plan. Let's reconvene after a quick break.
